*went up and down* is one idiomatic English rendering of the Hithpael, of which no morpheme owns a part; the internal *and* is inside that rendering rather than written beside it, so rule 14's last paragraph does not make it `added` and the head stays on the lexical verb (rule 44).
`בְּ` + `תּוֹךְ` → *among* meets rule 30's one-English-word condition and fuses here, in contrast with v.2 where the ASV writes *in the midst of* and rule 2 splits the pair.
